treatment_summary: The plan initiates guideline‑directed acute NSTEMI therapy (aspirin, ticagrelor, enoxaparin) plus secondary‑prevention measures (high‑intensity atorvastatin, ramipril, bisoprolol) and CKD‑targeted disease‑modifying therapy (dapagliflozin). NSAIDs, metformin, verapamil, diltiazem, pioglitazone and ACE‑I/ARB dual therapy are avoided due to renal impairment and heart disease. Monitoring of renal function, electrolytes, lipids, and bleeding is scheduled per NICE recommendations, and missing clinical data are flagged for clarification.
